claim_under_test: The unchanged source and this fixed operational task determine a single nonempty contextual-equivalence class of admitted implementations.

task.motivation: A reversible one-bit memory carried through typed route continuations, whose states remain readable and writable without changing the available source transitions.
task.observation: The current vertex and bit, at every authorized route boundary; readout labels are fixed, not quotiented by vertex-dependent bit relabelling.
task.contexts: All finite endpoint-correct directed words, including empty words, with the same read operation
task.allowed_update_grammar: Each original occurrence receives a Boolean permutation (identity or NOT), uniformly across uses; no added edges, resets or time-dependent policies.
required_laws: source-swap covariance with identity action on the bit
all eight vertex/bit configurations reachable from the fixed initial state
not_required: a prescribed bit value on a particular edge or loop
faithful encoding of every raw route into one bit

test: Exhaust all 64 Boolean-permutation edge assignments; check laws and finite-state reachability; compute contextual classes of the survivors using the complete reachable paired transition systems.
scope: A bounded mathematical countermodel to universal task-relative selection, not a physical experiment or a blind preregistered study. Task-relative classification into several classes is not refuted. The task and update grammar are explicit additional authority, not uniquely chosen by WG.
